briefing: This trail is a rewarding hike with a total distance of 3.7 km one way. Expect about 400 meters of climbing in total, with a steepest sustained climb of 340 meters gaining about 60 meters. The route features several steady climbs and scenic viewpoints. The highest point is 2165 m, and the lowest point is 1762 m.

cues.title: Start
cues.text: You are at the start of the Lake Agnes Trail. There are toilets and an information board here. A cafe is on your right, and Lake Louise comes into view on your right.

cues.title: Turn left
cues.text: Turn left at this junction. The path on the right is not your route. A drinking water tap is on your right, and a cafe is on your right.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right onto the Plain of Six Glaciers Trail. The path straight ahead is not your route. An information board is on your left, and a viewpoint is on your left.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right on the Plain of Six Glaciers Trail. About 40 meters later, continue straight on the Plain of Six Glaciers Trail. The path on the left is not your route.

cues.title: Viewpoint
cues.text: You will see a viewpoint beside the path here. There is a bench beside the path. Continue straight on the Plain of Six Glaciers Trail.

cues.title: Keep left
cues.text: Keep left on the Plain of Six Glaciers Trail. The road on the right is not your route. There is a bench beside the path.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: A steady climb starts here. It is 1.0 km long and gains 140 m. This section tops out at 1903 m.

cues.title: Viewpoint
cues.text: There is a viewpoint on your left. Continue straight on the Lake Agnes Trail. The path leaves the trees and is open for about 630 m.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: A steady climb starts here. It is 730 m long and gains 70 m. This section tops out at 1980 m. After this, the next 550 m climbs 60 m.

cues.title: Viewpoint
cues.text: You will see a viewpoint beside the path here. After this, the next 450 m is mostly level.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: A steady climb starts here. It is 540 m long and gains 90 m. This section tops out at 2070 m.

cues.title: Lake Agnes Trail
cues.text: You will cross a bridge on the Lake Agnes Trail. The path crosses a stream here.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right on the Lake Agnes Trail. The path straight ahead is not your route. Mirror Lake comes into view on your right, and a viewpoint is on your left.

cues.title: Viewpoint
cues.text: There is a viewpoint beside the path here.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: A steady climb starts here. It is 340 m long and gains 60 m. This section tops out at 2155 m. After this, the next 310 m climbs 60 m.

cues.title: Lake Agnes
cues.text: Lake Agnes comes into view on your right. There is a viewpoint on your right.

cues.title: The Big Beehive
cues.text: The Big Beehive is a summit on your left, about 220 m off the path. A flight of steps starts here, about 60 m long and climbs 9 m. Bridal Veil Falls is a waterfall beside the path.

cues.title: Finish
cues.text: This is the end of the route. There is an information board beside the path. Toilets are on your left.
